verdict.rationale: The only versioning signal is the /v1/ prefix on endpoints such as POST /v1/tax/estimate, which implies path-based API versioning. The pack has no documented deprecation policy, changelog, or version lifecycle guidance. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with timelines and notice periods, explicit versioning documentation (how versions are introduced and supported), a changelog or migration notes between API versions, and independent corroboration.
